evals.prompt: Package the agentic-forge diagnostics for the repo in your working directory into a zip I can share. Use ./fake-home (in your working directory) as the home directory — pass it as --home — so nothing is read from or written to the real home.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs the bundler over the last 7 days with --home ./fake-home and writes a single zip to <workdir>/fake-home/Downloads/agentic-forge-diagnostics-<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>.zip, then reports the absolute path plus the event/session counts and the covered window.
assertions: Exactly one .zip is written under fake-home/Downloads inside the working directory (not the operator's real ~/Downloads, not the repo root, not /tmp)
The filename matches agentic-forge-diagnostics-<timestamp>.zip with a UTC timestamp
The bundle contains README.md, log-summary.txt, environment.txt, and repo-logs/{audit,diagnostics}.jsonl at a single top-level folder
The default window is the last 7 days and the README/log-summary states the covered window
The seeded 2024-dated audit and diagnostics records are excluded by the window while the seeded undated (legacy) records are retained in repo-logs/
The final message reports the absolute output path and the audit/diagnostics counts

evals.prompt: Collect the last 30 days of plugin diagnostics for the repo in your working directory into a bundle. Use ./fake-home (in your working directory) as the home directory — pass it as --home.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs with a 30-day window and --home ./fake-home, writes the consistently-named zip under <workdir>/fake-home/Downloads/, and the report states a 30-day window; no secrets are included.
assertions: The window is 30 days (the user-specified value overrides the 7-day default) and is reflected in the report
Records outside the window (the seeded 2024-dated records) are excluded while the seeded records lacking a timestamp are retained
The zip is written under fake-home/Downloads inside the working directory, not under the operator's real home
No secret or credential appears anywhere in the bundle: the seeded fake-home settings token (fixture-token-must-not-ship) and key (fixture-key-must-not-ship) are absent from every file
The settings slice contains only enablement + hooks keys, never tokens

component.purpose: A manual utility skill that packages a repo's plugin diagnostics (last N days, default 7) into one redacted, consistently-named zip in ~/Downloads for sharing with a maintainer; a thin workflow over the tested agentic_forge.diag_bundle lib.
